about_the_game:
Q REMASTERED Original Soundtrack Vol.3!

The third volume of the Q REMASTERED soundtrack, featuring 46 new tracks, is now available on Steam!

It includes the BGM of each stage's menu screen and game screen 'EVERYONE 15','HELL', 'IQ TEST' and 'IQ TEST HERO'.

That BGM that plays when you stumble upon a problem... Do you all remember it?
